purpose: Validate the free CC BY University of Western Australia Deribit BTC-options dataset as a distinct historical source. This is not a rescue of the closed executable VRP MVE.
frozen_questions: Can at least one canonical data object be downloaded anonymously at zero cash cost?
Do rows identify option instrument, timestamp, price/trade quantity and expiry/strike/right?
Are bid/ask prices and bid/ask sizes present or absent?
What is the actual temporal span and row count?

classification_rules.UWA_TRADE_HISTORY_FULL: download succeeds; >=100000 option-trade rows; instrument identity and timestamps present; documented multi-year span substantially confirmed
classification_rules.UWA_TRADE_HISTORY_LIMITED: download succeeds and useful option-trade history exists but preferred breadth/schema is incomplete
classification_rules.UWA_SOURCE_BLOCKED: no canonical object can be obtained or core trade identity/timestamp fields are absent

nonclaims: Trade history is not executable BBO history.
No returns, PnL, VRP, volatility forecast score, expectancy or edge is computed by this gate.
No historical BBO-size claim may be inferred unless explicit size fields exist.
